evidence_primary_axes.description: Change which quantity is solved for / direction of relationship.
Change the sequence of dependent reasoning in a multi-step task.
Change the supplied evidence in a way that changes reasoning, not merely decoration.
Change graph/table/diagram/equation/verbal representation when the target supports translation or comparison.
Change meaningful values/geometry/shape while preserving the family.
Change the misconception/error students must diagnose.
Change from selected/short/constructed/matching/diagram when destination and target permit.
Change context only when it naturally changes or carries the evidence.
Change values/compatible units for procedural fluency.

surface_secondary_axes.description: Standard/Inverted/Context-rich. Secondary only; does not establish semantic independence by itself.
Names/objects may vary for naturalness but are weak evidence variation alone.
Choice order may vary but is not new evidence.
